3899-7084-8338.description:
Activate Spawning Pit by sacrificing another nonland creature you control
When the creature dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, earthbending a land.
Resolve the Spawning Pit ability, putting a charge counter on it.
Activate Spawning Pit by sacrificing the land
When the land dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, returning the land from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When the land enters, Shuttlecraft Galileo triggers, creating a 1/1 red Officer creature token
Resolve the Spawning Pit ability, putting a charge counter on it.
Repeat.

1981-2415-6772-8249.description:
Activate Defiant Salvager by sacrificing a creature
When the creature dies, Syr Vondam and Havoc Jester trigger.
Resolve the Syr Vondam trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and put a +1/+1 counter on Syr Vondam
Resolve the Havoc Jester trigger, dealing 1 damage to you.
Darien triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
Resolve Defiant Salvager's ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat.

2390-4185-6191.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
2390-4185-6191.description:
Gain life.
Celestial Unicorn triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it
All Will Be One triggers, dealing 1 damage to an opponent.
Bloodthirsty Conqueror triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
Repeat from step 2.

1251-5078-6766-8171.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {1}.
Vraska triggers, creating a 1/1 Sculpture Treasure artifact creature token.
Activate the token by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {1}.
Repeat.

728-3249-4242-5268.easyPrerequisites:
Utopia Vow attached to Grimgrin.
Grimgrin does not have summoning sickness.
728-3249-4242-5268.description:
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing Su-Chi, untapping Grimgrin and putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
When Su-Chi dies, it triggers, adding mana equal to its casting cost.
Activate Grimgrin's ability from Utopia Vow by tapping Grimgrin, adding one mana.
Activate Havengul Lich by paying {1}, allowing you to cast Su-Chi from your graveyard this turn.
Cast Su-Chi from your graveyard by paying its casting cost.
Repeat.

4222-4289-8039.description:
Activate Spireside Infiltrator by tapping it, adding {U}.
Spireside Infiltrator triggers, dealing 1 damage to each opponent
Activate Freed from the Real by paying {U}, untapping Spireside Infiltrator.
Repeat.

880-5478-7892.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional creature.
880-5478-7892.description:
Activate Perilous Forays by paying {1} and sacrificing a creature you control, searching your library for a land card with a basic land type and putting it on the battlefield untapped due to Spelunking.
When the land enters the battlefield, Thranduil the Strategist triggers, creating a creature token.
Activate the land by tapping it, adding {1}.
Repeat.

360-4399-4518-6626.description:
Cast Kor Skyfisher by paying {0} and 2 life due to Defiler of Faith and The Wind Crystal.
Defiler of Faith triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
When the Soldier enters, Soul Warden triggers, causing you to gain life.
Resolve Kor Skyfisher. When it enters, it and Soul Warden trigger.
Resolve the Kor Skyfisher trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Soul Warden trigger, causing you to gain life.
Repeat.
360-4399-4518-6626.notes: If your life total is below 3 to start, instead pay {W} when casting Kor Skyfisher for the first time.

2012-5256-6972.description:
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Strangleroot Geist
When Strangleroot Geist dies, its undying ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability.
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Strangleroot Geist
When Strangleroot Geist dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
Strangleroot Geist enters and dies as a state-based action due to having 0 toughness. Its undying ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability from step 4.
Repeat from step 4.
2012-5256-6972.notes: If Strangleroot Geist starts with a +1/+1 counter on it, then you may start the combo from step 4 instead.

527-1636-7609.notablePrerequisites: You control a creature with power 7 or greater.
527-1636-7609.description:
Activate Selvala by paying {G} and tapping it, adding at least {2}{G}{G}{U}{U}{R}.
Cast Savage Knuckleblade by paying {G}{U}{R}.
When Savage Knuckleblade enters, Intruder Alarm triggers, untapping all creatures.
Activate Savage Knuckleblade's second ability by paying {2}{U}, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

457-1792-3497-4404.easyPrerequisites: You control a creature that doesn't have summoning sickness.
457-1792-3497-4404.description:
Cast Retraction Helix by paying {U}, targeting a creature you control that doesn't have summoning sickness.
Cast Corridor Monitor by paying {U} due to Ezzaroot Channeler.
When Corridor Monitor enters, it triggers, untapping the creature targeted by Retraction Helix.
Activate Urza's first ability by tapping Corridor Monitor, adding {U}.
Activate the creature targeted by Retraction Helix by tapping it, returning Corridor Monitor from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat from step 2.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with a film counter on it

57-4846-6924-7297.notablePrerequisites: You control any number of permanents that enter untapped and that can collectively tap to produce at least {4}{R}.
57-4846-6924-7297.description:
Activate any number of permanents by tapping them, adding at least {4}{R}.
Activate Feldon by paying {2}{R} and tapping it, targeting Worldgorger Dragon.
Holding priority, activate Peter Parker's Camera by paying {2}, tapping and removing a film counter from it, copying Feldon's ability targeting Worldgorger Dragon.
Resolve the copy of Feldon's ability, creating a token copy of Worldgorger Dragon.
When the Worldgorger Dragon token enters, its first ability triggers, exiling all other permanents you control.
Resolve the Feldon ability from step 2, creating a token copy of Worldgorger Dragon.
When the Worldgorger Dragon token enters, its first ability triggers, exiling all other permanents you control.
When the Worldgorger Dragon token created in step 4 leaves the battlefield, its second ability triggers, returning all cards exiled with it to the battlefield.
Repeat.

3991-4681-5231.description:
Cast Faceless Butcher by paying its mana cost.
When Faceless Butcher enters, its first ability triggers, exiling Karmic Guide.
Activate Thermopod by sacrificing Faceless Butcher.
When Faceless Butcher dies, its second ability triggers, returning Karmic Guide from exile to the battlefield.
When Karmic Guide enters, it triggers, returning Faceless Butcher from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Faceless Butcher enters, its first ability triggers, exiling Karmic Guide.
Repeat from step 3.

1438-4395.easyPrerequisites:
Lightning Prowess attached to Eater of the Dead.
Eater of the Dead does not have summoning sickness.
1438-4395.notablePrerequisites: You have a way to give Eater of the Dead deathtouch.
1438-4395.description:
Give Eater of the Dead deathtouch by any method.
Activate Eater of the Dead by tapping it, dealing 1 damage to any nontoken creature an opponent controls.
The creature dies due to Eater of the Dead's deathtouch.
Activate Eater of the Dead by paying {0}, exiling the creature card from its owner's graveyard  and untapping Eater of the Dead.
Repeat.
You may also repeat this loop whenever a creature enters the battlefield under an opponent's control.

141-2034-3440.description:
Cast Demonic Gifts by paying its mana cost.
Holding priority, cast Naru Meha by paying its mana cost.
When Naru Meha enters, it triggers, copying Demonic Gifts, with the copy targeting Naru Meha.
Resolve the copy of Demonic Gifts.
Holding priority, activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Naru Meha.
When Naru Meha dies, it triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.

586-5256-5258-5618-6967.description:
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Priest of Gix.
When Priest of Gix dies, Rakdos triggers.
Holding priority, activate Haunted Crossroads by paying {B}, putting Priest of Gix from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Rakdos trigger, causing you to exile the top three cards of your library with the ability to play them until your next end step.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability from step 1.
Cast Priest of Gix from exile by paying {2}.
When Priest of Gix enters the battlefield, it triggers, adding {B}{B}{B}.
Repeat.

2034-3661-5220-6900.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Shield Sphere
When Shield Sphere dies, Mortuary triggers, putting Shield Sphere from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Cast Shield Sphere from the top of your library by paying 0 life.
Repeat.

1018-3647-3821.notablePrerequisites: You control up to five lands that can tap to produce at least {2}{U}.
1018-3647-3821.description:
Activate up to five lands by tapping them, adding at least {2}{U}.
Cast Displace by paying {2}{U}, blinking Skullwinder and Peregrine Drake
When Skullwinder and Peregrine Drake enter the battlefield, their abilities trigger.
Resolve the Skullwinder trigger, returning Displace from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Peregrine Drake trigger, untapping up to five lands.
Repeat.
1018-3647-3821.notes: If you control five lands that can tap to produce at least {3}{U}, this combo nets infinite mana, and you may blink any other permanent besides Peregrine Drake.

Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing an Elemental.
When the Elemental dies as an artifact due to Biotransference, Dross Scorpion triggers, untapping the creature with Elemental Mastery attached.
Repeat.

2511-3305-3817.description:
Activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing Sister Hospitaller.
When Sister Hospitaller dies, Body Launderer's first ability triggers, causing Body Launderer to connive.
Resolve the Bloodflow Connoisseur ability.
Activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing Body Launderer.
When Body Launderer dies, its second ability triggers, returning Sister Hospitaller from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Sister Hospitaller enters, it triggers, returning Body Launderer from your graveyard to the battlefield and causing you to gain 4 life.
Resolve the Bloodflow Connoisseur ability.
Repeat.

4052-4444-6264.notablePrerequisites: You have a card in hand.
4052-4444-6264.description:
Activate Noose Constrictor by discarding a card.
Cryptcaller Chariot triggers, causing you to create a tapped 2/2 Zombie creature token.
When the Zombie enters the battlefield, Kindred Discovery triggers, causing you to draw a card.
Resolve the Noose Constrictor ability.
Repeat.

2719-5330-5365.notablePrerequisites:
You control at least one Clue token.
Sakashima of a Thousand Faces on the battlefield as a copy of Lonis.
2719-5330-5365.description:
Activate Atog by sacrificing a Clue.
Lonis and Sakashima of a Thousand Faces's second abilities trigger.
Resolve the Lonis trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on Sakashima of a Thousand Faces.
Sakashima of a Thousand Faces's first ability triggers, creating a Clue artifact token.
Resolve the Sakashima of a Thousand Faces trigger from step 2, putting a +1/+1 counter on Lonis.
Lonis' first ability triggers, creating a Clue artifact token.
Resolve the Atog ability.
Repeat.
2719-5330-5365.notes: You may optionally target any other creature using one of the triggers to put infinite +1/+1 counters on that creature.

864-4872-6122.notablePrerequisites: {1}{U} available plus enough mana to cast Time Warp and Eternal Witness each turn.
864-4872-6122.description:
Cast Time Warp by paying its mana cost, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Cast Eternal Witness by paying its mana cost.
When Eternal Witness enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Time Warp from your graveyard to your hand.
Move to your next turn.
Activate Dour Port-Mage by paying {1}{U} and tapping it, returning Eternal Witness from the battlefield to your hand.
Dour Port-Mage triggers, causing you to draw a card.
Repeat.

780-1126-4871.description:
During your precombat main phase, cast Supernatural Stamina by paying {B}, targeting Xiahou Dun.
Activate Xiahou Dun by sacrificing it, targeting Supernatural Stamina.
When Xiahou Dun dies, it and Pitiless Plunderer trigger.
Resolve the Pitiless Plunderer trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Xiahou Dun trigger, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Xiahou Dun ability from step 2, returning Supernatural Stamina from your graveyard to your hand.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Repeat.

549-1365-3967-4853--20.notablePrerequisites:

When the creature dies, its persist ability and Dross Scorpion trigger.
Resolve the persist trigger, returning the creature from your graveyard to the battlefield, which enters the battlefield with at least one +1/+1 counter on it due to its bloodthirst ability.
Resolve the Dross Scorpion trigger, untapping Cauldron of Souls.
Resolve the Yahenni ability.
Repeat.

2842-4050-5544.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Forsaken Miner, adding {B}.
When Forsaken Miner dies, Blood Artist triggers.
When you commit that crime, Forsaken Miner triggers, causing you to pay {B} to return it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Blood Artist trigger, causing target opponent to lose 1 life and gaining 1 life.
Repeat.

2867-2981-4636-5391.description:

Activate Megatog by sacrificing the Robot.
When the Robot dies, Demon of Dark Schemes' second ability triggers, causing you to get {E}.
Resolve the Megatog ability, giving it +3/+3 until end of turn.
Repeat.

2976-3147-4019-5227.notablePrerequisites:

Utopia Srawl triggers, adding one mana of the chosen color.
Activate Vigean Graftmage by paying {1}{U}, untapping Azorius Chancery.

198-1978-3789.description:

198-1978-3789.notes: The combo assumes Empowered Autogenerator has no charge counters on it when you start. If it has charge counters, the mana cost is reduced by {1}.

231-1479-3200.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one Plains that enters the battlefield untapped.
231-1479-3200.description:
Activate Urza's Bauble by tapping and sacrificing it, causing you to look at a card in a player's hand and draw a card at the beginning of the next upkeep.
Activate Tameshi by paying {W} and returning any Plains that enters the battlefield untapped to your hand from the battlefield, returning Urza's Bauble  from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Urza's Bauble enters the battlefield, Kodama of the East Tree triggers, putting a Plains from your hand onto the battlefield.
Activate the Plains by tapping it, adding {W}.
Repeat.

1912-3099-3767-4289.notablePrerequisites: You control a Sliver that does not have summoning sickness.
1912-3099-3767-4289.description:
Activate any Sliver by tapping it, adding one mana of any color.
Leyline of Abundance triggers, adding {G}.
Activate the tapped Sliver by paying {1}, untapping it.
Repeat.
Once you have a large amount of mana, you may use it to activate Leyline of Abundance, putting infinite +1/+1 counters on creatures you control.

1624-3625-3646-4499.notablePrerequisites: Tree of Redemption does not have summoning sickness.

Storvald enters the battlefield, causing Tree or Redemption's power and toughness to become one until end of turn.
Activate Tree of Redemption by tapping it, causing your life total to become one.
At the beginning of your upkeep, Near-Death Experience triggers, causing you to win the game.

1124-1283-2495.description:
Tap Chromatic Orrery for {5}.
Pay {4} and tap The Chain Veil to allow you to activate Tezzeret's ability.
+1 Tezzeret to untap Chromatic Orrery and The Chain Veil.

At the beginning of your next upkeep, Progenitor Mimic triggers, creating a token copy of Possessed Skaab.
When the token Possessed Skaab enters the battlefield, it triggers itself, returning Capture of Jingzhou from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

2540-4449-4893.notablePrerequisites:
At least one +1/+1 counter on Hateflayer.
Hateflayer does not have summoning sickness.
2540-4449-4893.description:
Activate Hateflayer by tapping it, adding {R}.
Activate Hateflayer by paying {R} and untapping it, causing it to deal damage equal to its power to any target.
Repeat.

2770-3508-4879.easyPrerequisites: You control a destructible land that enters the battlefield untapped and can tap to produce at least {1}.
2770-3508-4879.description:
Cast Donate by paying {2}{U}, causing target opponent to gain control of Price of Glory.
During an opponent's turn, activate any land by tapping it, adding at least {1}.
Price of Glory triggers, destroying the land.
Sacred Ground triggers, returning the land from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.

751-1741-2499.notablePrerequisites: You control up to two lands that can tap to produce at least {1}{U}.
751-1741-2499.description:
Activate up to two lands by tapping them, adding at least {1}{U}.
Cast Cloud of Faeries by paying {1}{U}.
When Cloud of Faeries enters the battlefield, it triggers twice.
Resolve the first trigger, untapping up to two lands.
Holding priority, activate up to two lands by tapping them, adding at least {1}{U}.
Resolve the second Cloud of Faeries trigger, untapping up to two lands.
Cast Shrieking Drake by paying {U}.
When Shrieking Drake enters the battlefield, it triggers twice, returning it and Cloud of Faeries from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.
